stops.note: to sift, to distinguish, combined with dis- (apart)
to sift apart, to discern, from dis- and cernere, with irregular past participle discretus
carried into French for someone careful and wise in speech
settled as the English word for being careful to avoid embarrassment or attention
stops.meaning: careful to avoid embarrassment or unwanted attention

current_meaning: careful and judicious in speech or behavior, avoiding unwanted attention
